name: Member ID
meaning: The library's number for the member, printed on their card.

name: Name
meaning: What the member is called.

name: Email
meaning: How the library contacts the member. Unique among members (TL-LEND-INV01).

name: Joined at
meaning: When the member was registered.

name: Tool ID
meaning: The library's number for the tool, written on its tag.

name: Name
meaning: What the tool is.

name: Description
meaning: Anything a borrower should know; may be blank.

name: Condition
meaning: Whether the tool is fit to lend. A new tool starts good.

name: Added at
meaning: When the tool joined the catalog.

name: Note
meaning: What is wrong with the tool.

name: Reported at
meaning: When the damage was reported.

name: Loan ID
meaning: The library's number for the loan.

name: Member
meaning: Who borrowed the tool.

name: Tool
meaning: Which tool was borrowed.

name: Borrowed at
meaning: When the loan started.

name: Due date
meaning: The last day of the loan, in the library's time zone (TL-LEND-INV04).

name: Renewed at
meaning: When the member renewed the loan, once (TL-LEND-INV07); none until then.

name: Reminded at
meaning: When the library reminded the member the loan is due, once (TL-LEND-INV08); none until then.

name: Returned at
meaning: When the tool came back.

name: Condition
meaning: The tool's condition as the librarian found it.

name: Note
meaning: What the librarian noticed. A blank note is none.
